prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one transparent PNG source sheet 1536x1024 for a grounded post-apocalyptic pixel survival RPG. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows of invisible 512x512 cells. Category: Боеприпасы — три игровых типа. Cell contents MUST follow these positions: TOP LEFT: a closed SMALL blue-gray ammunition carton with a simple pistol silhouette pictogram, no readable text; TOP MIDDLE: a closed LONG olive ammunition carton with a simple long rifle silhouette pictogram, no readable text; TOP RIGHT: a closed SQUARE red-brown shell carton with a simple shotgun shell pictogram, no readable text; BOTTOM LEFT: the same small blue-gray ammunition carton OPEN showing a few small brass-colored cartridge tips inside, no loose ammunition; BOTTOM MIDDLE: the same long olive ammunition carton OPEN showing long brass-colored cartridge tips inside, no loose ammunition; BOTTOM RIGHT: the same square red-brown carton OPEN showing red shotgun shell tops inside, no loose ammunition.  Each occupied cell has exactly ONE complete isolated item silhouette or the explicitly requested matched pair; do not duplicate items. Generous 48px transparent margins inside every cell, never crop or merge neighboring items. Consistent crisp square-pixel 16-bit game art, muted olive, canvas brown, gray steel, faded cloth, dark selective pixel outlines, restrained highlights, moderate wear. Slightly elevated readable RPG inventory view; clothing shown from front with a tiny 3/4 turn, empty with no person or mannequin. Detailed but truly pixelated, no photorealism, smoothing, antialiasing, painterly gradients or 3D render. True transparent background, no floor, no ground plane, no cast shadows, no decorative backdrop, no text, no labels, no readable letters or numbers, no brands, no hands, no people. Preserve distinguishable silhouettes and tier-specific construction. No socks, guns or detachable ammunition magazines. Ammunition BOXES are allowed only in the ammunition category, and those images must not contain loose diagrams or instructions. All items must remain visibly distinct. This is artwork for a fictional game, not a real-world instruction sheet.
